paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance change brought by different sizes of the in-context pool.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the performance change of various methods with respect to different sizes of the in-context pool, represented by the ratio on the x-axis, which ranges from 0 to 1 with a linear scale and no units. The y-axis represents minADE20, with a linear scale, ranging from 0.55 to 0.75, and no units. The plot features five lines, each representing a different method: TrajIACL (blue, solid line with no markers), Head Tuning (orange, solid line with no markers), FT (green, solid line with circle markers), LoRA 16 (red, solid line with no markers), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line with no markers). The TrajIACL line starts at approximately 0.61 and ends at approximately 0.60. The Head Tuning line starts at approximately 0.78 and ends at approximately 0.69. The FT line starts at approximately 0.68 and ends at approximately 0.55. The LoRA 16 line starts at approximately 0.72 and ends at approximately 0.60. The LoRA 64 line starts at approximately 0.74 and ends at approximately 0.61.
model_annotations.German: The diagram displays the relationship between the ratio and minADE20, comparing the performance of five different methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis represents the ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents minADE20, also with a linear scale, spanning from 0.55 to 0.75 in intervals of 0.05. TrajICL is depicted by a blue line with circle markers, starting at approximately 0.60 minADE20 at a ratio of 0.1, showing a slight decrease to around 0.59 at a ratio of 0.3, before stabilizing around 0.60. Head Tuning is represented by an orange line with circle markers, beginning at about 0.79 minADE20 at a ratio of 0.1 and gradually decreasing to around 0.69 at a ratio of 1.0. FT is shown as a green line with circle markers, starting at roughly 0.68 minADE20 at a ratio of 0.1, decreasing sharply to around 0.55 at a ratio of 0.7, and continuing to decline slightly to about 0.54 at a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 16 is illustrated by a red line with circle markers, beginning at approximately 0.75 minADE20 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to around 0.61 at a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 64 is represented by a purple line with circle markers, starting at about 0.74 minADE20 at a ratio of 0.1 and declining to roughly 0.61 at a ratio of 0.7, before leveling off.
